ops.title: yasyf-home state after swarm death (2026-07-25 sweep): repair target is sync.sock/stale binaries, NOT acct-18
ops.body:
Read-only Phase B sweep of yasyf-home (rebooted Jul 24 05:11 PDT; swarm debris cleared by the reboot — no codex procs, no wedged daemonkit-worker, load healthy).

**The original complaint is stale**: `acct-18 content catch-up: context deadline exceeded` — the literal `content catch-up` string appears in no log; `acct-18` last seen 2026-07-21 00:19 (benign "deferred: 2 live sessions" form); `context deadline exceeded` last fired Jul 19, zero since the reboot. Do not chase it; re-check only after convergence.

**Live faults**:
1. synckitd serve (PID up, synckitd 0.23.0 — 13 minors stale) dials `~/.cc-pool/sync.sock`; nothing serves it → 105/200 recent errors are dial-refused, rest are `wire: handshake failed: read |0: file already closed` (mixed-era wire signature). Root cause understood: sync.sock is served by the **cc-pool daemon, spawned on demand via syncEnsureDaemon** (cc-pool internal/cli/sync.go:141, internal/daemon/syncserver.go:51) — no launchd agent exists or is meant to. Nothing ensured the daemon post-reboot. Repair = brew upgrade synckitd+cc-pool to baseline-pinned releases, then run a cc-pool sync command to ensure the daemon (or let a converged synckitd do it).
2. Crash loops from stale binaries: com.yasyf.cc-notes.contentd (`unknown command "contentd"`, cc-notes 0.39.2 vs 0.47.6) and synckit cookiesync (`unknown command "rpc-serve"`, synckitd 0.23.0 vs 0.36.1). Upgrade before restarting — restarting without upgrading just resumes the loop.
3. com.cc-steer.watch crash loop is UNRELATED (cc-steer 0.19.0 StoreSchema `extra_ddl` packaging bug) — separate ticket, not part of fleet repair.

**Inventory**: zero `agent/*` bookmarks and zero unpushed commits across all ~69 repos on the machine. Only substantive WIP: captain-hook 4 dirty files (exports.py new + testing/helpers.py + docs + tests — coherent export-surface change) — PRESERVE until reviewed. daemonkit and cc-patch have no footprint on this host (not installed, not cloned). ~/.cc-pool holds 956MB of swarm hotfix/cutover archives — keep as evidence for now.

Machine convergence (brew upgrades) deliberately waits for the frozen-baseline downstream releases (stabilization plan A4/A5) — a partial upgrade now would create another mixed-era intermediate, the exact failure mode being fixed.
